content.title: Add a task with Enter using a typed title
content.intent: Prove that typing a task title and pressing Enter creates one new task in the todo list and shows that typed title in the list.
content.technique_notes: Applied equivalence partitioning with one representative valid input class: a typed task title. Negative and boundary techniques were reviewed but not minted because the current source does not define blank-title behavior, title limits, or alternate submission outcomes; those remain captured by gaps **gap-2** and **gap-3**. No covering array was needed because this path has one asserted input dimension and one grounded outcome.
